name: Greater Than London Dry Gin
owner: Diageo India (United Spirits Limited) – majority stake in NÄO Spirits
history: 2015 | Two Delhi bar owners, frustrated by the lack of gin, bought a copper pot still and developed their own recipe
expressions: Greater Than Juniper Bomb Gin | three times the juniper
Greater Than Broken Bat Gin | limited edition, cask-aged with toasted Kashmir willow
Greater Than No Sleep Gin | coffee-themed
Hapusa Himalayan Dry Gin | sister brand, foraged Himalayan juniper
serve_official: Gin & Tonic garnished with rosemary or lemon (Gin Guild)
notes: Awards per Master of Malt: Silver Asian Spirits Masters 2023; Silver London Spirits Competition 2022; Silver World Gin Awards 2021; Silver The Gin Masters 2020; Bronze ISC 2020. Gin Guild says NÄO Spirits is based in New Delhi; MoM lists Goa.
